series.title: Eyes Of Fire Series
series.author: Malik A. Ahmed
series.lore: Area 51 underground experiments, time fracture to medieval 1400s Italy, the stitched leather mask, and the legend of the woman with burning eyes.
series.description: An epic series following a woman with burning eyes.

books.title: THE WOMAN OF FIRE (EYES OF FIRE BOOK 1)
books.blurb:
The people I left behind were never the people I thought they were.

I grew up believing that the first hands to hold me would be...

excerpts.title: The People I Left
excerpts.content:
The metal walls of the bunker felt colder than usual...

Time was a fracture, an illusion I was about to break.

excerpts.title: What's Left in Me?
excerpts.content:
I opened my eyes and the world was burning.

Not with fire, but with a light that shouldn't exist in 1400s Italy.

books.title: Eyes of Fire: Volume 2
books.blurb: The next chapter in the Eyes of Fire series.
